configuration.reason: The prompt source is chosen per request. A stored subscription credential on the plan that covers these calls keeps the provider-configured behaviour, so the pacing stays with whoever pays for the inference; every other account runs the prompt this app ships. A covered account never silently falls back to the bundled prompt when its configuration read fails.

subscription.selectedWhen: stored Codex credential present and its token tier is pro
subscription.cacheScope: account and user, permitting token refresh

bundled.selectedWhen: no stored credential, or a tier other than pro

configuration.responseSchema: single nullable suggestion field, additionalProperties false

eligibility.planGate: stored credential tier read locally from the access token; the session's own model source is irrelevant to it
eligibility.subscription: not required; it selects the provider-configured path
eligibility.fingerprint: turn and the resolved account principal, so signing a covered account in or out retires in-flight work while model and model-source switches keep suggestions grounded in the same turn
eligibility.modelSwitch: preserve settled and in-flight suggestions for the same turn; retry only model-dependent failures when the model or source changes

sourceTurn.appendedRow: a user row the host appends without a turn (a friend's message) reserves the next generation and becomes the source while no turn runs; it is persisted, so a resumed session agrees
sourceTurn.resumed: highest persisted admission generation, with legacy retained-context fallback
sourceTurn.clockTies: admission generation independent of context append order
sourceTurn.rollback: persist a clear watermark and use retained transcript
sourceTurn.renderer: resolve named engine context before selecting the per-turn cache; revisions track history and turn lifecycle, not the stream object identity
sourceTurn.revisionReason: Unrelated immutable stream updates must not discard every pending source reply and prevent prediction lookup.
sourceTurn.liveUserRevision: the uuid of the newest live user row is part of the revision, compared as a scalar, so a pushed friend message re-reads the source; the host pushes that row only after the engine accepted it
sourceTurn.cancelledRead: abort queued source admission before restoring a retired binding

recovery.ordinaryRefresh: no retry for the same source revision
recovery.predictionCache: preserve successful, empty, sampled-out and failed inference results
